div.p:
for now hardware will use ESP32-S3 it will communicate with
application with USB serial through Flatbuffer message custom
protocol.

application will using Slint for user interface and
Surealism UI for the ui library, we will not using
direct call to sidecar function, rather we will use
api call served by caligula_api, so other application
client like web or mobile able to develop by relying
on the caligula_api

side car is software that support app to run and serving as
main gate for other client application, in this project
sidecar is a server with Actix-Web

firmware will contain simple parser from Flatbuffer no_std
it will parse message from the application, and interpret
the action based on predefined command inside firmware.

caligula_api will serving endpoint that will be use by
application

caligula_driver will contain custom Flatbuffer message
and USB serial to communicate with firmware

caligula_migration will contain simple migration logic
for saving data into Firebird SQL in embedded mode (no server)

caligula_shared is place to save code that possibly
will used in other client library other than the api.
for now it will contain openapi-generator-cli rust
request.
placing coagulation container and click start button on the

g.text: prepare command to be send to ESP32
check if ph match with nigari recipe
